Order and product invariants stay in domain methods, so the file only orchestrates. It has no persistence code, no transport or HTTP handling and no framework logic. The empty-items guard is borderline: it could arguably sit in the Order constructor as an invariant. It is not clearly a misplaced responsibility, so it doesn't fail the rule.
